researcher_notes: 11 source files (+1 byte-identical duplicate of XS1-IntelliCart, moved together), all a uniform 4pp datasheet template. This is a strong variant-completion case: the DB has 6 generic product rows (L2, M4, S3, X1, XS1, GT1 spin) but the source documents 11 named sub-variants (L2-core/lift, M4-core/lift/tow, S3-core/tow, X1-core/lift-1200/spin, XS1-IntelliCart, GT1-spin). Mapping used: the '-core' (or, for XS1/GT1, the only available) variant of each family enriches the existing generic DB row; every other named sub-variant becomes a NEW product. EXCEPTION/FLAG: the DB's existing 'SAFELOG AGV M4' row is already classified product_type=Tugger AGV (not Mobile AMR like its siblings) -- since M4-tow (not M4-core) is the sub-variant that actually matches a Tugger's towing function, this run enriches 'SAFELOG AGV M4' with the M4-TOW datasheet instead of M4-core, and creates M4-core and M4-lift as two NEW Mobile AMR products instead. By the same logic, a NEW 'SAFELOG AGV S3 tow' was independently classified Tugger AGV here (its own fresh judgment call, since S3 tow has no existing DB row to inherit from) even though the existing 'SAFELOG AGV S3' row (enriched from S3-core here) is Mobile AMR -- flagging this split for Tech Lead review. Turning-radius footnote figures in the technical-data table extracted ambiguously/unreliably across several files (a superscript-footnote-marker digit appears to merge with the actual value in the linearized text) -- turning_radius/min_turning_radius was ONLY filled where a plain-prose body-text statement existed (M4 family: 'turning radius of 1m'), and deliberately left null everywhere else rather than trust the ambiguous table footnote. S3's body text states a rotation DIAMETER ('less than 90cm') rather than a radius -- not converted to min_turning_radius, per the same radius/diameter caution already flagged for VisionNav VNK15/Magazino SOTO/Geek+ this run. 'Conformity CE, FCC' (and IP54 on several models) is a recurring Company-level fact, not written to any Base Model field (certifications_generic is Company-entity scope).
